about.headline: Engineering a clearer future.
about.description: Oiyo Wiki is the family's reference library — from saju, tarot, astrology, myth, and dream interpretation to psychology, lifestyle, and finance terms. Concepts are verified and cross-linked so they make sense together.
about.philosophyText: We structure scattered knowledge against primary sources and established scholarship. The more open a topic is to interpretation, the more we surface sources and limits — and we cross-link entries with tools and in-depth articles.
about.coverItem1Text: Saju (stems·branches·gods), 78 tarot cards, astrology, myth, dreams, oracle.
about.coverItem2Text: The MBTI 16-type matrix and personality/relationship terms.
about.coverItem3Text: Tax, investing, solar terms, holidays — everyday concepts, defined.
about.quote: The best way to predict the future is to engineer it.
about.teamHeading: Who writes this — our editorial desks
about.teamIntro: OIYO content is not written by an anonymous individual but by topic-specific editorial desks that verify against primary sources and public statistics. Each desk's remit:
about.methodText: Every piece (1) checks facts against primary sources, official statistics, and academic literature; (2) states limits and disclaimers for sensitive topics like psychology and health; and (3) carries an updated date and is revised on a regular cycle when the topic changes. Our goal is to give you a basis to judge for yourself rather than a verdict.
